suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as extraintestinal infection complication. Require documented Entamoeba histolytica infection/amebiasis and separately documented amebic liver abscess using appropriate clinical/imaging/laboratory evidence. Do not infer hepatic abscess from intestinal colonization alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Amebiasis and Amebic Liver Abscess
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented Entamoeba histolytica infection/amebiasis and separately documented amebic liver abscess using appropriate clinical/imaging/laboratory evidence. Do not infer hepatic abscess from intestinal colonization alone.
